Callout.Name: Garage Break-In
Callout.Message: Residential garage broken into, bicycles taken.
Callout.Advisory: Shed and garage both forced, owner at work.

Script.Line: The side door was open. I was looking to see what had been taken.
The bikes are mine. All three of them are mine.
Check the frames. There are numbers on the frames.

Lines.Approach: Both doors forced and the bikes are gone. Owner is on his way home.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
